metadata.title: Stocks Fall as Warsh Commits to Inflation Fight | Aug. 28 Review & Preview<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Review & Preview: Warsh Gets Real on Inflation
Warsh’s Reality. In his first Jackson Hole speech as chairman of the Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh reminded the market that he isn’t just paying lip service to rising prices. Warsh called out “65 months of sustained, elevated inflation” and noted that two years of progress in bringing down price growth has been “modest.”
